decision: Implement the existing historical-context consumer next; keep full current-window transparency acceptance OPEN. This is design evidence, not implementation, actual validation, claim, or start authorization.

findings: FlowClient.contextHistory(taskId, signal) returns at most one latest-by-eventSequence observation for current_attempt_id, not all history and not a current-window snapshot.
Requested/resolved models are historical frozen request and host observation; resolved may be null. Selected next-message model is separate.

current and remaining are always unknown/history-only; modelCapacity unknown; compactionWindow and used can only be correctly attributed SDK estimates. Never synthesize current percentage or remaining.
observedAt and receivedAt are separate; sequence does not establish freshness. Do not borrow general ContextSnapshot freshness/cut rules absent from this endpoint.
v1 materials can supply bounded citation/locator bytes, tokens null; v2 attachments produce unknown metadata. Unknown is not zero, unused, unsupported, or not compressed.
Transport/auth/conflict/schema/identity failure differs from no attempt/no observation; no failure becomes healthy unknown.
Schema 65536B bound is not an enforced streaming network limit in the current client. No invented claim of transport bound.

experience.entry: Existing plugin-contributed Context button in chat.composer.actions opens explicit accessible disclosure/dialog; use existing chat.composer.context panel slot. Preserve official assistant-ui Thread, composer, drafts and Arc view identity.
experience.headline: Context observation. Present current window / remaining as unavailable from history. Show Last observed estimate only when supplied; do not render a numeric ring for history-only data.
detail: Historical requested and observed model with source/version/method/token basis, exact observation and received time, task/attempt reference. Label selected next-message settings separately if exposed by existing settings surface; never reuse them as observed execution identity.
Strategy-window estimate is not a model hard limit. Material exact refs/bytes are not token costs or residence proof.
Explicitly expand sample detail using existing authorized detail reader; preserve detail ref and exact selected observation identity. No eager body reads.
Click/Enter/Space opens; Escape closes and restores originating visible button focus. Works on touch, 390px, light/dark, reduced motion. Error/unknown labels must remain legible without color.

lifecycle: A private typed ContextHistoryReaders port on AppActions calls the existing FlowClient; plugins never receive client credentials or unrestricted fetch. Authorization checks before and after await.
Bind controller to existing AppPluginSession (center connection lifetime), stable viewKey and ConversationProjection. Navigation/split/merge must not recreate authority or remount Thread.

Read target is the selected conversation turn/task (initially last turn), not an invented conversation-wide aggregate. Identity carries session/view/conversation/task and current request generation; returned attempt/session/profile/input remain labeled historical identity.

Open/explicit refresh starts bounded one-inflight read; no timer, repeated model/token-count calls, global event subscription per keystroke, or load of all past tasks. Close/hidden pane/revocation/disposal aborts and makes late response inert.

Task/connection/view identity switch clears current target and detail; task attempt changes observable from existing projection invalidate. For identity components not available in current projection, do not invent a freshness guarantee; next explicit refresh obtains center-selected current attempt.

Draft/model/material edits cannot transform historical result into current data. Keep historical label with exact binding; do not recompute from token sums. No writes to outbox, model settings, materials, or recovery journal.

Use immutable stable snapshots and a dedicated controller subscription; notify only changed context-history state. Reuse existing host registration/enable/disable and PluginView failure boundary; disabled plugin aborts reads.

pluginDesign.preferred: Register a real plugin command/button/panel, with private owner-bound read adapter; context-history domain state in its own module. Add narrow task.context.read capability to Web types and validation if no existing precise capability is adopted; declaration is not authority, private session/view checks still required.

meaningful: Pure controller: target switch and late response, abort/disable/dispose, one inflight read and explicit retry, null attempt vs no observation, error vs unknown, source and identity preservation.

Contract-aligned HTTP fixture and browser: legitimate estimate including zero, unknown, requested != resolved/null, v2 materials unknown, never show current remaining/ring, lazy detail request count, two visible split views and hidden/closed cleanup, preserved drafts, keyboard/touch, light/dark390px screenshots.

validation.noRepeat: No broad rerun of already green Arc/model tests for metadata; run focused checks after implementation and one bounded browser window assigned by manager.

aiElements.observed: Official Context is a compound usage/cost hover-card with ratio presentation and tokenlens cost support; a display component cannot establish backend context identity or comparability.
aiElements.decision: Use only semantics supported by real history contract. Do not inject fake maxTokens/usedTokens, cumulative task usage, guessed model catalog capacity or price. Local source compatibility review pending w01. Accessible click disclosure takes precedence over hover-only details.
